spec: ISA0.9 §10.1 explicit root accuracy; bennett.estimate-accuracy/1; §11 schedule matching; §17.9 default epsilon_share
derivation: The caller-supplied epsilon=1/10 survives absent and mismatched schedule bindings; a matching schedule may be reused only at the same exact rational accuracy. Three inexact operations receive default share 1/30. Legacy entries obtain accuracy only from a schedule matching all other bindings, retaining its bytes and explicit zero if present. Otherwise they return BENNETT_E_ARG with E_ESTIMATE_ACCURACY_REQUIRED and direct the caller to the additive API, with NULL estimate output and no effects. No numerical root-accuracy default is selected. Bound legacy rows establish accuracy resolution only, not a completed estimate.
